CustomField.description: If true, payments with a status of “Pre-Pending” will also be included in the settlement delay. If false, only payments with a status of “Pending” will be included in the settlement delay.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If true, payments with a status of “Pre-Pending” will also be included in the settlement delay. If false, only payments with a status of “Pending” will be included in the settlement delay.
CustomField.label: Pre-Pending Payments in Settlement Delay
